cn.t: Cole Escola's audacious farce about Mary Todd Lincoln earns widespread acclaim as one of the season's funniest shows, with critics hailing Escola as a comedic genius delivering 80 uproarious minutes of camp brilliance.

vr.q: Seeing Oh, Mary! at the Lucille Lortel Theater was one of the most enjoyable theater going experiences I've had in awhile.
